title: 语言模型安全纠错：冻结基座调整与能力保持
summary: 提出CRN v2轻量级logit纠错模块（约34M参数，占4.65B文本模块的0.73%），在完全冻结的Gemma 4 E2B上通过SFT和DPO训练，纠正53.3%的基座错误且不损害MMLU/BoolQ等能力；KL保持项至关重要，LoRA基线虽纠错率更高但能力损失30-75%。
summary_en: Proposes CRN v2, a lightweight logit-level correction module (~34M params, 0.73% of the 4.65B text module) atop a fully frozen Gemma 4 E2B, trained via SFT and reference-free DPO. It corrects 53.3% of base-model errors with no degradation on MMLU/BoolQ, while a LoRA baseline achieves 83.3% correction but loses 30-75% capability; the KL preservation term is critical.
